scopeBasis: Bounded re-evaluation of five residual hard cases carried over from TOKYO-WAVE-3, -13 and -17. No new candidate discovery.
policyBasis: docs/VENUE_DATA_GUIDE.md as it now stands. Exact agreement with a published total, rangeDiff 0, a fully resolved wheelchair substitution and an issuer-authored explanation of a mapped-versus-published difference are confidence metadata, not production gates. The gate is a complete, losslessly structured printed numbered set for the declared representative scope, with no invented seat IDs, no capacity fitting, no unsupported seat deletion and no invented block ownership. The Wave21 display-area policy was available but was not needed for any of these five venues.

venues.priorBlockerResolution: The Wave17 hold rested on a false premise. It assumed the printed 902 had to be reduced to 896 because the chart also names six wheelchair spaces. The chart's own heading table reads 1階客席数480席 (固定席436 + 移動可能席44) and 2階客席数422席, whose sum is exactly 902 = 総客席数902席, and 車椅子スペース6席 is a separate line outside that arithmetic. The vector text layer holds exactly 902 printed numbers, and the transcription splits 480 / 422 across the two printed area names, so there is no contradiction and no seat had to be deleted.
venues.structureNote: 1階席 rows あ〜て and 2階席 rows け〜ふ. Both area names are printed on the chart. The 2F side wings (け〜つ, seats 1-4 and 33-36) and the 2F rear block share one 1-36 numbering axis, exactly as the 1F rows do; the wings are 2F because 1F front + 1F centre is exactly the issuer's 480.
notIncluded: 車椅子スペース6席（無番号・見出し表の別項目）

venues.venue: 杉並区立社会教育センター(セシオン杉並)〔ホール〕
venues.priorBlockerResolution: The Wave17 hold cited only the six-seat difference between 497 printed numbers and the 503 published room capacity. Under the current guide that difference alone is not a blocker. The 497 printed set was re-extracted from the PDF's text layer and is complete: rows 1-19 (15/17/21/23/25/9/9 then twelve rows of 31) plus the printed 親子席 row 20 seats 1-6.
venues.unresolvedDifference: The six-seat gap is plausibly the two unnumbered wheelchair marks drawn beside rows 6 and 7, but the issuer states no count, so it is kept as metadata. No seat number was added.
notIncluded: 6・7列左右の無番号車椅子マーク区画

venues.venue: 瑞穂ビューパーク・スカイホール〔大ホール〕
venues.priorBlockerResolution: The Wave17 hold cited 1,006 printed cells against the issuer's 1,002 fixed seats. The source is a 4677x6614 monochrome scan with no text layer, so the count was redone twice and independently: magnified block-by-block visual transcription (far-left 1-4, left 5-16, centre 17-28, right 29-40, far-right 41-44 across rows 1-27) gives 1,000, and connected-component seat-cell detection on a 500 dpi render gives 997-999 with the missed cells individually identified as ones crossed by dimension lines or dashed borders. The recorded 1,006 does not reproduce under either method.
venues.expectedSeatCountChoice: expectedSeatCount is the venue's published 座席数 1,008席, matching the repository convention already used for tokyo-wave3-1188 (854) and tokyo-wave3-0991 (500) where the headline capacity includes unnumbered wheelchair spaces. The 固定席1,002 subtotal and the 車いす席6 line are held separately in scopeDisclosure, wheelchairSemantics and unresolvedIssues, so the explained 6 and the unexplained 2 stay distinguishable.
venues.unresolvedDifference: 1,000 printed numbers versus the issuer's own 固定席1,002. Two seats are unexplained; nothing was added or removed.

venues.venue: 昭和女子大学 人見記念講堂
venues.priorBlockerResolution: The Wave13 hold said the curved side number groups carry no issuer-defined row/area ownership. They do not need one to be read: each block is drawn as a set of straight row lines, and the line counts match the issuer's printed row labels one-to-one (1F left and right 34 lines each against rows 2-35; 1F outermost 26 lines; 2F all blocks 12 lines against rows A-L). The issuer's own note 「8列8,9,10,45,46,47は車椅子兼用席」 identifies the first outermost line as row 8 on both sides. Reconstructing the blocks with their rake offsets yields 1階ホール 1,538席 and 2階ホール 532席, matching the issuer's client-count table exactly, and 2,070 in total.
venues.structureNote: 1F rows 2-35 on a 1-54 numbering axis; 2F rows A-L on a 1-50 axis. Rows 20 and 35 have no outermost-block seats and 2F rows G-I are cut by the staircases, both matching the drawing.
venues.wheelchair: 8列8,9,10,45,46,47 are printed numbered seats flagged as 車椅子兼用席 and are kept in the set.

venues.venue: 東京オペラシティ コンサートホール:タケミツ メモリアル
venues.priorBlockerResolution: The recorded blocker was that the chart drew 1-LB/1-RB blocks totalling 58 seats that the published 972/358/302 subtotals did not account for. That does not reproduce on the current chart dated 2026.8: the first floor is rows 1-31 with left 1-10, centre 11-22 and right 23-32 only, with no LB/RB blocks. Every floor now reconciles: 1F 964 printed + 8 wheelchair = 972; 2F 356 printed (side L1 61 + L2 39 + R1 61 + R2 39, rear C1-C5 130, organ-front P 26) + 2 wheelchair = 358; 3F 302 printed (side L1 66 + L2 40 + R1 66 + R2 40, rear C1-C3 90). Total 1,622 printed + 10 wheelchair = 1,632.
venues.structureNote: Odd/even first-floor rows alternate between 32 seats (1-32) and 31 seats (1-32 without 22); rows 12 and 31 hold 4-29 without 22 because the wheelchair positions replace the block ends. All row labels (1-31, L1/L2/R1/R2, C1-C5, C1-C3, P) are issuer-printed.

hardCaseRecount.method: Mechanical recount over all 15 files in data/venue-inventory (1,266 items) after the Wave22 integration. Buckets are mutually exclusive; each item falls in exactly one.

bucketDefinitions.type-only-deferred: Blocked only by the pre-representative-layout structural prefilter ("固定番号席による単一代表パターンを定義できない" / "固定番号席の一意な代表配置を定義できない"). DEFERRED, not a permanent reject.
bucketDefinitions.missing-numbered-map: The official facility page is located or unreachable but no complete numbered map has been read yet; ordinary un-done research, not a hard case.
bucketDefinitions.count-contradiction: A named CONTRADICTION or MISMATCH hold between the printed numbered set and an issuer subtotal.
bucketDefinitions.ownership: A named hold because segmented or side number groups have no issuer-defined row/area ownership.
bucketDefinitions.evidence-hold-other: Any other named SOURCE / POLICY / SCHEMA / B_SOURCE_LIMITED / DATE hold against an identified current official source.
bucketDefinitions.closed-or-renovation: Closed, long-term closed, or under seat-changing renovation.
bucketDefinitions.other-blocked: Blocked with no recorded reason or a reason that matches none of the above.

hardCaseIndicator.definition: hard case = a blocked inventory item carrying an evidence-grade hold against an identified current official source, i.e. count-contradiction + ownership + evidence-hold-other. It excludes the 130 type-only deferrals, the 58 not-yet-researched or unreachable sources, the 15 closed/renovation entries, the 22 unattributed blocks, the 780 not-started candidates, the 4 REJECTs and the 2 independent-review-mismatch records.
hardCaseIndicator.priorFigureNote: The previously reported "本当に難案件: 86件" is not reproducible from the inventory under any of these definitions. The closest reproducible figure is blocked-and-operationally-active, which was 87 before this wave and is 82 after it; that measure mixes the type-only deferrals and un-researched sources into the same number. Use the 41-item hard-case indicator above instead.

validation: Targeted reviews for all five venues, Wave22 batch report, inventory report, readiness report, release coverage, venues:build/check/validate/report, production fingerprint additions, then canonical npm run verify:venues.
exactNextAction: Do not open a new wave without explicit authorization. The reopenable hard-case inventory is the 41 items enumerated by the recount above; the highest-value Tokyo entries are listed in the NEXT OPUS BATCH note in docs/HANDOFF.md.
